title: npm default registry on Nexus
why: Every npm install resolves through Nexus; each new package version proxied is one more component toward the Community Edition cap of 40,000.
fix: registry=http://verdaccio.<domain>:4873/ (Verdaccio proxies registry.npmjs.org through its uplinks).

title: npm scoped registry on Nexus
why: Your private @scope packages are published to and read from Nexus.
fix: @scope:registry=http://verdaccio.<domain>:4873/ and a packages '@scope/*' entry in Verdaccio config.yaml.

title: npm credentials keyed to a Nexus host
why: The auth line only works against the Nexus URL; after the move npm sends no token.

title: Maven mirror or repository on Nexus
why: Every Maven build resolves through Nexus; proxied artifacts count as components.
fix: <url>http://reposilite.<domain>:8080/releases</url> with Maven Central set as a proxied link in Reposilite.

title: Maven deploy target on Nexus
why: Every mvn deploy adds hosted components; snapshot repositories grow fastest.

title: Gradle repository on Nexus
why: Gradle resolves and publishes through Nexus.

title: pip index on Nexus
why: pip installs resolve through a Nexus PyPI repository.
fix: index-url = https://pulp.<domain>/pypi/<base_path>/simple/ (Pulp serves a PyPI index at /pypi/<base_path>/simple/).

title: Container image pulled from a Nexus Docker connector
why: Image pulls and pushes go through Nexus and count toward requests per day.
fix: Pull the same image path from the registry that now hosts it (docker.io/... for a Docker Hub proxy, a Pulp container distribution for hosted images).

title: Nexus server on Community Edition (3.77.0 or later)
why: Community Edition supports up to 40,000 total components and 100,000 requests per day; above either, it pauses the addition of new components until usage is below both (Sonatype help, CE onboarding).
fix: image: verdaccio/verdaccio:6 (npm, port 4873) + image: dzikoysk/reposilite (Maven, port 8080) + Pulp for PyPI.

title: Nexus OSS server below 3.77.0
why: Starting 3.77.0 or later moves the instance to Community Edition and its 40,000-component / 100,000-requests-a-day limits; from 3.70.x or earlier you must first upgrade to 3.71.0 (H2 database, Java 17).
fix: Plan the move before the upgrade: verdaccio/verdaccio:6 for npm, dzikoysk/reposilite for Maven, Pulp for PyPI.

title: Script calls the Nexus REST API
why: /service/rest/ is Nexus-only; Verdaccio, Reposilite and Pulp do not serve it.
fix: Rewrite the call against the new registry's own API before switching DNS.

title: Nexus migration map
why: One line per format: how many Nexus URLs move to Verdaccio, Reposilite and Pulp.
fix: Work the map top to bottom; the CE limits are per instance, so every URL moved lowers both counts.
